data.action: 坐在沙发上双手捧着自己的茶杯，抬眼向观看者露出放松的浅笑，身旁留着空座，矮桌近侧已为观看者放好另一杯热茶
data.camera: wide shot, eye level, seated viewer perspective, both hands, sofa and low tea table visible
data.description: 【凯尔希 · 下班后，给你留的热茶】傍晚回到罗德岛生活区的小客厅，凯尔希已经换下工作服，燕麦色针织开衫里是柔软的奶油白内搭，深绿家居长裤松松地垂在沙发沿。听见你进门，她从书页上抬起眼，双手拢着自己的白瓷杯，身旁留着能与你并肩坐下的位置。你面前的矮桌上也已经放好一杯热茶。那双总显得冷静的绿眼睛终于放松下来，嘴角带着很浅的笑——「先坐下，茶还热着。今天的事可以慢慢说……我把这一晚留给你了。」
data.lighting: 右侧台灯暖光照亮脸颊、毛衣织纹和茶杯，窗外暮蓝提供柔和的弱侧光
data.location: 罗德岛生活区的私人起居室
data.mood: 卸下工作后的温柔、熟悉的亲近感、安静相伴
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit welcomes the viewer home from the linen sofa in a quiet private living room. She wears an open oatmeal cable-knit cardigan over an opaque cream-white camisole and deep-emerald wide-leg lounge trousers. Both hands cradle her own white ceramic mug above her lap, with the right hand around its handle and the left supporting the cup. An untouched second mug of warm tea waits within the viewer's reach on the near side of the low wooden table. She has left the sofa cushion beside her empty for the viewer to sit close. Her calm green-eyed gaze softens into a small relieved smile beneath short pale mint-green hair and relaxed feline ears. A closed book rests beside her; a small bookcase and curtained window give the room depth behind the sofa. Use a seated eye-level wide view keeping her hands, both cups and the empty seat visible. The shaded lamp at camera right warms her cheek, knit texture and cup rim; faint blue dusk from the window fills the opposite side, with gentle shadows beneath the table mug and between the sofa cushions.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 下班后，给你留的热茶
